page_title: WHU 2-2 BUR | West Ham v Burnley 10/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' That looked a certain handball by Sander Berge (Burnley) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
90+6' Danny Ings (West Ham) picked up a rebound and unleashed a fine effort which crashed against the crossbar.
90+3' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) replaces Vitinho.
90+3' Sander Berge (Burnley) receives a decent pass from Josh Brownhill and immediately goes for goal from mid-range. It's a fine strike but the ball goes just over the bar.
90+1' 2 - 2 Danny Ings (West Ham) reacts quickly in the penalty area and scores with aplomb, giving the goalkeeper no chance!
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
88' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for West Ham due to an offside in the build-up play.
88' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The West Ham players aren’t happy.
86' Goal! Michail Antonio shows great vision to find Danny Ings (West Ham) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the middle of the goal. 2:2.
84' Darren England shows a yellow card to Maxime Esteve (Burnley) for his blatant foul.
83' The referee cannot ignore such behaviour. Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) sees a yellow card and needs to watch himself for the rest of the game.
82' The substitution has been made. Danny Ings (West Ham) has replaced Nayef Aguerd.
82' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the middle of the goal, but James Trafford keeps it out with an amazing save.
80' The foul by Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) was seen by Darren England who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
78' The corner evades everyone in the centre and ends up at the back post where Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) sends a wild header high over the bar.
78' Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) will take a corner kick.

77' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. The ball goes behind for a corner. West Ham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
76' Yellow card. Sander Berge (Burnley) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
74' Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

74' Michail Antonio (West Ham) evades several challenges inside the box and fires a shot in on goal, but that's a great block by the defender to stop an almost certain goal. The referee signals a corner kick to West Ham.
72' Hannes Delcroix (Burnley) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
71' David Datro Fofana (Burnley) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
70' James Trafford displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Michail Antonio (West Ham) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
68' A substitution has been made. Wilson Odobert goes off and Hannes Delcroix (Burnley) comes on.
67' Josh Cullen (Burnley) takes a short corner kick.
65' Jarrod Bowen tees up Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) with a precision cross. He holds off the defender, but fires his shot just over the bar.
64' What was Lorenz Assignon (Burnley) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
63' An attempted cross from Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) is cleared.
62' James Trafford (Burnley) attempts to delay the restart of play. The referee doesn't like it.
61' Maxime Esteve (Burnley) picks up an injury.
60' West Ham enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
58' Josh Cullen (Burnley) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
57' Vitinho (Burnley) is first to the rebound and attempts to beat the keeper from long range. It's a decent effort, but flies just wide of the left post.
56' What a chance that is! Michail Antonio sends a great ball towards Lucas Paqueta (West Ham), whose shot from the edge of the box flies a whisker wide of the left post.

55' David Datro Fofana (Burnley) accelerated away from the defence and took his shot early from the edge of the box. The ball flew low towards the middle of the goal, but Alphonse Areola made a superb athletic save to deny him.
54' Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
53' There's an opportunity for Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
52' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The ball is out of play and West Ham manage to earn a corner.
52' Darren England blows for a foul after Sander Berge (Burnley) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
51' Charlie Taylor (Burnley) tries his luck with a shot from long range, but his effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
50' Darren England blows his whistle as Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.

46' 1 - 2 Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) weaves his way past several defenders and finds himself in a one-on-one with the keeper. His dummy throws the keeper off balance and he simply puts the ball into the back of net.
46' David Moyes makes a half-time substitution. Michail Antonio comes on in place of James Ward-Prowse (West Ham).
46' Half-time substitution. Kalvin Phillips (West Ham) will not participate anymore and Edson Alvarez is coming on.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) is replaced by Josh Brownhill.
46' The whistle blows and Darren England starts the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' 0 - 2 What bad luck! Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) got in the way of a pass and unintentionally sent the ball past his own goalkeeper. The score is 0:2.
45+1' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) shows brilliant individual skill to find some space and tries his luck from long range, but the shot flies well wide of the left post.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Alphonse Areola reacts well to deny a long-range free kick from Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) towards the middle of the goal.
44' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Darren England had an easy-decision to make.
43' Flag goes up against Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
42' West Ham exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely.
41' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 0:1.
40' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
37' The corner from Josh Cullen (Burnley) is hurriedly cleared.
37' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Burnley win a corner.
36' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
34' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) was too forceful with his tackle and Darren England interrupted the game to signal a free kick. West Ham have a free kick.
32' Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) nutmegs the defender on the edge of the box and lashes in a shot at goal that flies well wide of the left post.
32' The ball is cleared after Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

30' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
29' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) spurns a big chance! He makes himself some space to meet a cross and from near the penalty spot sends a header well wide of the left post!
28' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) takes a cheeky throw-in and sets up a counter-attack for his team.
27' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
24' Burnley are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
22' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
21' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
19' Sander Berge (Burnley) is penalised for a foul. Darren England had a clear view and blows his whistle.
17' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) produces a cunning chipped pass for Lucas Paqueta, who takes it down well but fails to get past the defenders and loses the ball.
16' A pass into the penalty area from Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) is intercepted by the defence.

14' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The linesman signals a throw-in for Burnley.

11' 0 - 1 What a spectacular moment! David Datro Fofana (Burnley) skips past defenders and finds some space before blasting a long-range strike at goal. The fans are amazed when they see the ball go into the top right corner. The scoreline is 0:1.
11' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) sees his long-range effort blocked.
10' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) tries to find Mohammed Kudus, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
8' Burnley hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
7' Lorenz Assignon (Burnley) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
6' Lorenz Assignon (Burnley) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
4' Charlie Taylor (Burnley) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alphonse Areola intercepts the ball.
3' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
1' Charlie Taylor (Burnley) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
1' The first half has started.
Burnley will kick the game off.
Darren England is the one to supervise the game today.
